theorems.statement: ∀ {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : A →+ A) [Fintype f.ker] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∣ Fintype.card f.ker → ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ f a = 0 ∧ p • a = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Apply additive Cauchy's theorem to the finite kernel to obtain an element of additive order p. It is nonzero because zero has order one and p is prime. Kernel membership gives f(a)=0, and inclusion into A carries its p-fold sum to zero.
